name: – After § 3 – Am 7
title: Resolution on the need for the EU’s continuous support for Ukraine
part_text: 3c. Condemns the continuous large-scale Russian attacks on civilian infrastructure, including energy facilities, residential areas, schools and hospitals; urges Russia to immediately cease all hostilities, bombardments and attacks against civilians; demands that all parties fully comply with their obligations under international humanitarian law and respect and protect humanitarian personnel and consignments used for humanitarian relief operations; stresses that those responsible for war crimes must be held accountable in accordance with international law;
